home.metaTitle: Dr. Getúlio Amaral Filho — Nephrologist and Integrative Functional Medicine in Londrina
home.metaDescription: Nephrologist (CRM-PR 21,876 · RQE 16,038), professor, author of the book "Antes — A Janela Silenciosa". Clinical director at Plenya. Practice in Londrina, Brazil.
home.ogTitle: Dr. Getúlio Amaral Filho — Nephrology, longevity, teaching
home.ogDescription: Nephrologist, professor, author. Clinical director at Plenya. Twenty years of internal medicine and nephrology practice.

hero.lead1: Twenty years inside the hospital taught me that much serious disease begins years earlier — silently, in "normal" lab results.
hero.lead2: The medicine I practice today looks for that interval. It's about what comes before — and about coordinating, over the long term, a person's whole-of-health.

pillars.doctorBody: Practices at two clinics in Londrina — preventive medicine and longitudinal care management at Plenya, clinical nephrology at Nefroclínica — and serves as technical director for in-hospital hemodialysis.
pillars.professorBody: Coordinator of the nephrology medical residency at Santa Casa de Londrina for over a decade.
pillars.authorBody: "Antes — The Silent Window Between Normal and Optimal" (2026, Brazilian Portuguese).
pillars.speakerBody: Lectures for physicians, residents and corporate audiences — on prevention that begins before.

book.quote: Between what the lab calls normal and what the body can reach as optimal, there are ten to twenty years of silent window.
book.coverAlt: ANTES — The Silent Window Between Normal and Optimal
